                    )

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# R1 – each shipment assigned to exactly one truck
for i in range(N_shipments):
    model += (
        pulp.lpSum(assign[(i, t)] for t in range(N_trucks)) == 1,
        f"R1_assign_{i+1}",
    )

# R2 – each truck handles at most one shipment
for t in range(N_trucks):
    model += (
        pulp.lpSum(assign[(i, t)] for i in range(N_shipments)) <= 1,
        f"R2_truck_{t+1}",

for i in range(N_shipments):
    for k in range(steps_per_shipment - 1):

            >= start[(i, k)] + handling_time[i][k],

    model += (

    if (i, k) < (j, l):

            order[(i, k, j, l)] + order[(j, l, i, k)] == 1,
            f"R5_order_{i+1}_{k+1}_{j+1}_{l+1}",

    )

# R8 – start times are already non‑negative via lowBound=0 (no extra constraint needed)

for i in range(N_shipments):

# Objective – minimise makespan
model += makespan, "Objective"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

model.solve(pulp.HiGHS(msg=False, timeLimit=120))

print(f"Minimum makespan: {pulp.value(makespan)}")

import pulp

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Data
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
fields = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]
practices = ["Practice1", "Practice2", "Practice3",
             "Practice4", "Practice5", "Practice6"]

runoff_coeff = {
    "A": 0.652,
    "B": 1.697,
    "C": 1.504,
    "D": 2.215,
    "E": 1.726,
    "F": 2.774,
}

area = {
    "A": 68.373,
    "B": 70.198,
    "C": 202.074,
    "D": 66.421,
    "E": 118.754,
    "F": 208.269,
}

reduction_rate = {
    "Practice1": 0.46,
    "Practice2": 0.64,
    "Practice3": 0.10,
    "Practice4": 0.48,
    "Practice5": 0.54,
    "Practice6": 0.42,
}

cost_per_area = {
    "A": {"Practice1": 28.844, "Practice2": 143.338, "Practice3": 172.031,
          "Practice4": 133.674, "Practice5": 156.103, "Practice6": 146.96},
    "B": {"Practice1": 50.854, "Practice2": 95.795,  "Practice3": 53.414,
          "Practice4": 74.397,  "Practice5": 96.165,  "Practice6": 89.038},
    "C": {"Practice1": 28.066, "Practice2": 91.085,  "Practice3": 136.37,
          "Practice4": 81.117,  "Practice5": 39.001,  "Practice6": 185.367},
    "D": {"Practice1": 22.755, "Practice2": 168.037, "Practice3": 27.714,
          "Practice4": 28.347,  "Practice5": 150.371, "Practice6": 164.236},
    "E": {"Practice1": 115.71, "Practice2": 121.428, "Practice3": 116.701,
          "Practice4": 72.633,  "Practice5": 33.224,  "Practice6": 77.184},
    "F": {"Practice1": 136.415, "Practice2": 152.554, "Practice3": 174.938,
          "Practice4": 147.002, "Practice5": 193.996, "Practice6": 124.078},
}

P = 0.376  # required fraction of baseline load to be removed

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Pre‑computed baseline loads
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
baseline_load = {f: runoff_coeff[f] * area[f] for f in fields}
total_baseline = sum(baseline_load.values())

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model = pulp.LpProblem("NutrientRunoffReduction", pulp.LpMinimize)

# Decision variables: fraction of each field treated with each practice
x = pulp.LpVariable.dicts(
    "x",
    [(f, p) for f in fields for p in practices],
    lowBound=0,
    upBound=1,
    cat="Continuous",
)

# Auxiliary variables
eff = pulp.LpVariable.dicts("eff", fields, lowBound=0, upBound=1, cat="Continuous")
red_load = pulp.LpVariable.dicts("red_load", fields, lowBound=0, cat="Continuous")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# R1 – bounds on fractions
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
for f in fields:
    for p in practices:
        model += x[(f, p)] >= 0, f"R1_lower_{f}_{p}"
        model += x[(f, p)] <= 1, f"R1_upper_{f}_{p}"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# R4 – effective reduction factor for each field (linearised)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
for f in fields:
    model += (
        eff[f]
        == pulp.lpSum(reduction_rate[p] * x[(f, p)] for p in practices),
        f"R4_{f}",
    )

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# R5 – reduced load for each field
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
for f in fields:
    model += (
        red_load[f]
        == baseline_load[f] - baseline_load[f] * eff[f],
        f"R5_{f}",
    )

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# R6 – total reduction requirement
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model += (
    pulp.lpSum(red_load[f] for f in fields)
    <= (1 - P) * total_baseline,
    "R6_total_reduction",
)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# R2 – total cost (objective)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
total_cost = pulp.lpSum(
    cost_per_area[f][p] * area[f] * x[(f, p)] for f in fields for p in practices
)
model += total_cost, "R2_total_cost"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Solve
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model.solve(pulp.HiGHS(msg=False, timeLimit=120))

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Output
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

print(f"Total implementation cost: ${pulp.value(total_cost):,.2f}\n")

    for p in practices:

        if val is not None and val > 1e-6:
            print(f"  Field {f}, {p}: {val:.4f}")

print("\nEffective reduction factor per field:")

    print(f"  Field {f}: {eff[f].varValue:.4f}")

print("\nReduced load per field (baseline load units):")
for f in fields:
    print(f"  Field {f}: {red_load[f].varValue:.4f}")

print(
    f"\nTotal baseline load: {total_baseline:.4f}"
)
print(
    f"Total reduced load: {pulp.value(pulp.lpSum(red_load[f] for f in fields)):.4f}"
)

}

# Required overall reduction fraction
P = 0.636

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model = pulp.LpProblem("Water_TDS_Reduction", pulp.LpMinimize)

# Decision variables: fraction of each technology applied at each outlet (continuous 0‑1)
x = {}
for o in outlets:
    for t in techs:
        var_name = f"x_{o}_{t}"
        x[(o, t)] = pulp.LpVariable(var_name, lowBound=0, upBound=1, cat="Continuous")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# R1 – Variable bounds (explicitly named)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
for o in outlets:
    for t in techs:
        model += x[(o, t)] >= 0, f"R1_{o}_{t}_lower"
        model += x[(o, t)] <= 1, f"R1_{o}_{t}_upper"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# R2 – Fractional removal per outlet cannot exceed 100%
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
for o in outlets:
    model += (
        pulp.lpSum(removal[t] * x[(o, t)] for t in techs) <= 1,
        f"R2_{o}"
    )

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# R3 – Overall TDS reduction must be at least P of baseline
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

baseline = sum(coeff[o] * flow[o] for o in outlets)

# Remaining discharge after treatment

    coeff[o] * flow[o] * (1 - pulp.lpSum(removal[t] * x[(o, t)] for t in techs))
    for o in outlets
)

# Constraint: remaining <= (1 - P) * baseline
model += remaining <= (1 - P) * baseline, "R3_overall"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# R4 – Objective: minimize total implementation cost
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
total_cost = pulp.lpSum(
    cost[(o, t)] * flow[o] * x[(o, t)] for o in outlets for t in techs
)
model += total_cost, "R4_total_cost"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

model.solve(pulp.HiGHS(msg=False, timeLimit=120))

        print(f"  {o} - {t}: {val:.4f}")

print(f"\nOverall TDS reduction achieved: {reduction_fraction:.4%} (required ≥ {P:.2%})")

import pulp

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Data
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Benefit coefficients
benefit = {
    "A": 0.155,
    "B": 0.194,
    "C": 0.097,
    "D": 0.022,
    "E": 0.067,
    "F": 0.112,
    "G": 0.113,
    "H": 0.124,
    "I": 0.124,
    "J": 0.100,
}

# Environmental impact coefficients
impact = {
    "A": 0.123,
    "B": 0.234,
    "C": 0.181,
    "D": 0.155,
    "E": 0.110,
    "F": 0.017,
    "G": 0.040,
    "H": 0.131,
    "I": 0.289,
    "J": 0.044,
}

# Allocation limits
lower = {
    "A": 0.094,
    "B": 0.014,
    "C": 0.031,
    "D": 0.046,
    "E": 0.021,
    "F": 0.048,
    "G": 0.048,
    "H": 0.044,
    "I": 0.070,
    "J": 0.032,
}
upper = {
    "A": 0.480,
    "B": 0.786,
    "C": 0.369,
    "D": 0.810,
    "E": 0.689,
    "F": 0.706,
    "G": 0.399,
    "H": 0.890,
    "I": 0.446,
    "J": 0.405,
}

# Rapid‑delivery set and its minimum share
rapid_set = ["A", "G", "H", "I"]
rapid_min_share = 0.482

# Global limits
env_max_total = 0.168
benefit_min_total = 0.074
total_budget = 1.0

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model = pulp.LpProblem("plan", pulp.LpMaximize)

# Decision variables: budget share for each project
x = {}
for p in benefit.keys():
    x[p] = pulp.LpVariable(f"x_{p}", lowBound=0, upBound=None, cat="Continuous")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Objective: maximize total community benefit
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model += pulp.lpSum(benefit[p] * x[p] for p in benefit), "Objective_Benefit"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Requirements (constraints)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# R1: allocation bounds for each project
for p in benefit.keys():
    model += x[p] >= lower[p], f"R1_{p}_lower"
    model += x[p] <= upper[p], f"R1_{p}_upper"

# R2: total budget must equal 1.0
model += pulp.lpSum(x[p] for p in benefit) == total_budget, "R2_budget"

# R3: rapid‑delivery projects must receive at least 0.482 of the budget
model += pulp.lpSum(x[p] for p in rapid_set) >= rapid_min_share, "R3_rapid_min"

# R4: total environmental impact must not exceed 0.168
model += pulp.lpSum(impact[p] * x[p] for p in impact) <= env_max_total, "R4_env_max"

# R5: total community benefit must be at least 0.074
model += pulp.lpSum(benefit[p] * x[p] for p in benefit) >= benefit_min_total, "R5_benefit_min"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Solve
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model.solve(pulp.HiGHS(msg=False, timeLimit=120))

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Output results
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
print("Status:", pulp.LpStatus[model.status])
print("Objective (total benefit):", pulp.value(model.objective))
print("\nAllocation:")
for p in sorted(x.keys()):
    print(f"  {p}: {x[p].varValue:.6f}")

print("\nVerification:")
total_impact = sum(impact[p] * x[p].varValue for p in impact)
total_benefit = sum(benefit[p] * x[p].varValue for p in benefit)
rapid_share = sum(x[p].varValue for p in rapid_set)
print(f"  Total budget (should be 1.0): {sum(x[p].varValue for p in x):.6f}")
print(f"  Rapid‑delivery share (>= {rapid_min_share}): {rapid_share:.6f}")
print(f"  Environmental impact (<= {env_max_total}): {total_impact:.6f}")
print(f"  Community benefit (>= {benefit_min_total}): {total_benefit:.6f}")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Data
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
facilities = [
    "Alpha", "Beta", "Gamma", "Delta",
    "Epsilon", "Zeta", "Eta", "Theta"
]

# travel times (minutes) – symmetric, so we add both directions
travel = {
    ("Alpha", "Beta"): 119.4,
    ("Alpha", "Gamma"): 12.5,
    ("Alpha", "Delta"): 175.0,
    ("Alpha", "Epsilon"): 43.9,
    ("Alpha", "Zeta"): 103.2,
    ("Alpha", "Eta"): 159.5,
    ("Alpha", "Theta"): 125.2,
    ("Beta", "Gamma"): 110.1,
    ("Beta", "Delta"): 125.0,
    ("Beta", "Epsilon"): 153.9,
    ("Beta", "Zeta"): 36.1,
    ("Beta", "Eta"): 98.4,
    ("Beta", "Theta"): 39.6,
    ("Gamma", "Delta"): 174.5,
    ("Gamma", "Epsilon"): 56.4,
    ("Gamma", "Zeta"): 91.8,
    ("Gamma", "Eta"): 157.3,
    ("Gamma", "Theta"): 119.1,
    ("Delta", "Epsilon"): 180.7,
    ("Delta", "Zeta"): 156.4,
    ("Delta", "Eta"): 26.9,
    ("Delta", "Theta"): 85.5,
    ("Epsilon", "Zeta"): 143.6,
    ("Epsilon", "Eta"): 171.1,
    ("Epsilon", "Theta"): 150.5,
    ("Zeta", "Eta"): 130.6,
    ("Zeta", "Theta"): 72.0,
    ("Eta", "Theta"): 59.1,
}

# make the dictionary symmetric
symmetric_travel = {}
for (i, j), t in travel.items():
    symmetric_travel[(i, j)] = t
    symmetric_travel[(j, i)] = t

num_facilities = 8          # from parameters
start_facility = "Alpha"    # designated start
M_MTZ = 8                   # big‑M for MTZ constraints

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model = pulp.LpProblem("Technician_Tour", pulp.LpMinimize)

# Decision variables: binary arcs
x = {}
for i in facilities:
    for j in facilities:
        if i != j:
            var_name = f"x_{i}_{j}"
            x[(i, j)] = pulp.LpVariable(var_name, cat="Binary")

# MTZ position variables (continuous)
u = {}
for i in facilities:
    var_name = f"u_{i}"
    # Alpha (the start) is fixed to 1, others are bounded 2..M_MTZ
    if i == start_facility:
        u[i] = pulp.LpVariable(var_name, lowBound=1, upBound=1, cat="Continuous")
    else:
        u[i] = pulp.LpVariable(var_name, lowBound=2, upBound=M_MTZ, cat="Continuous")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Objective: minimise total travel time
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model += (
    pulp.lpSum(symmetric_travel[(i, j)] * x[(i, j)] for i in facilities for j in facilities if i != j),
    "Total_Travel_Time"
)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Requirements as named constraints
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# R1: each facility has exactly one outgoing arc
for i in facilities:
    model += (
        pulp.lpSum(x[(i, j)] for j in facilities if i != j) == 1,
        f"R1_outgoing_{i}"
    )

# R2: each facility has exactly one incoming arc
for j in facilities:
    model += (
        pulp.lpSum(x[(i, j)] for i in facilities if i != j) == 1,
        f"R2_incoming_{j}"
    )

# R3: MTZ subtour elimination (only for non‑start nodes)
for i in facilities:
    for j in facilities:
        if i != j and i != start_facility and j != start_facility:
            model += (
                u[i] - u[j] + M_MTZ * x[(i, j)] <= M_MTZ - 1,
                f"R3_MTZ_{i}_{j}"
            )

# R4: enforce start facility position (already fixed by bounds) and
#     ensure the tour starts/ends at Alpha (implicit via R1/R2)
#     we still add an explicit constraint for clarity.
model += (
    u[start_facility] == 1,
    "R4_start_position"
)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Solve
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
solver = pulp.HiGHS(msg=False, timeLimit=120)
model.solve(solver)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Output
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
print(f"Status: {pulp.LpStatus[model.status]}")
print(f"Total travel time: {pulp.value(model.objective):.2f} minutes\n")

print("Tour arcs (i -> j) where x = 1:")
for (i, j), var in x.items():
    if pulp.value(var) > 0.5:
        print(f"  {i} -> {j} (time = {symmetric_travel[(i, j)]} min)")

print("\nMTZ positions:")
for i, var in u.items():
    print(f"  u_{i} = {pulp.value(var)}")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Data
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
facilities = ["P", "Q", "R", "S", "T", "U"]
n = len(facilities)

# Travel times (minutes) – symmetric
travel = {
    ("P", "Q"): 37.1, ("Q", "P"): 37.1,
    ("P", "R"): 49.0, ("R", "P"): 49.0,
    ("P", "S"): 77.3, ("S", "P"): 77.3,
    ("P", "T"): 66.9, ("T", "P"): 66.9,
    ("P", "U"): 61.0, ("U", "P"): 61.0,
    ("Q", "R"): 24.1, ("R", "Q"): 24.1,
    ("Q", "S"): 89.1, ("S", "Q"): 89.1,
    ("Q", "T"): 40.0, ("T", "Q"): 40.0,
    ("Q", "U"): 27.7, ("U", "Q"): 27.7,
    ("R", "S"): 74.0, ("S", "R"): 74.0,
    ("R", "T"): 59.7, ("T", "R"): 59.7,
    ("R", "U"): 16.3, ("U", "R"): 16.3,
    ("S", "T"): 129.2, ("T", "S"): 129.2,
    ("S", "U"): 89.0, ("U", "S"): 89.0,
    ("T", "U"): 52.4, ("U", "T"): 52.4,
}

# Big‑M constant for MTZ subtour elimination
M = 1000

# Choose a start facility (arbitrary – here we use "P")
start = "P"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model = pulp.LpProblem("Technician_Tour", pulp.LpMinimize)

# Decision variables
# x[i,j] = 1 if arc i→j is used, 0 otherwise (binary)
x = {}
for i in facilities:
    for j in facilities:
        if i != j:
            var_name = f"x_{i}_{j}"
            x[(i, j)] = pulp.LpVariable(var_name, cat="Binary")

# u[i] = position of facility i in the tour (continuous)
u = {}
for i in facilities:
    u[i] = pulp.LpVariable(f"u_{i}", lowBound=0, cat="Continuous")

# total_time variable (continuous)
total_time = pulp.LpVariable("total_time", lowBound=0, cat="Continuous")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Requirements as named constraints
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# R1 – exactly one outgoing arc from each facility
for i in facilities:
    model += (
        pulp.lpSum(x[(i, j)] for j in facilities if j != i) == 1,
        f"R1_outgoing_{i}",
    )

# R2 – exactly one incoming arc to each facility
for j in facilities:
    model += (
        pulp.lpSum(x[(i, j)] for i in facilities if i != j) == 1,
        f"R2_incoming_{j}",
    )

# R3 – MTZ subtour elimination for all i != j
for i in facilities:
    for j in facilities:
        if i != j:
            model += (
                u[i] - u[j] + M * x[(i, j)] <= M - 1,
                f"R3_MTZ_{i}_{j}",
            )

# R4 – ordering variable bounds (2 ≤ u[i] ≤ |Facilities|) for all i ≠ start
for i in facilities:
    if i != start:
        model += (u[i] >= 2, f"R4_lower_{i}")
        model += (u[i] <= n, f"R4_upper_{i}")

# R5 – start facility ordering
model += (u[start] == 1, "R5_start_order")

# R6 – binary restriction is already enforced by variable type (no extra constraint needed)

# R7 – total travel time definition
model += (
    total_time
    == pulp.lpSum(travel[(i, j)] * x[(i, j)] for i in facilities for j in facilities if i != j),
    "R7_total_time_def",
)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Objective
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model += total_time, "Minimize_Total_Travel_Time"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Solve
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model.solve(pulp.HiGHS(msg=False, timeLimit=120))

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Output
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
print(f"Status: {pulp.LpStatus[model.status]}")
print(f"Minimum total travel time: {pulp.value(total_time):.2f} minutes")

# Reconstruct the tour order
tour = []
current = start
visited = set()
while True:
    visited.add(current)
    tour.append(current)
    # find the next facility
    next_fac = None
    for j in facilities:
        if current != j and pulp.value(x[(current, j)]) > 0.5:
            next_fac = j
            break
    if next_fac is None or next_fac == start:
        break
    current = next_fac

tour.append(start)  # return to start
print("Tour order:", " -> ".join(tour))

import pulp

# -----------------------------
# Data
# -----------------------------
C = ["C1", "C2", "C3", "C4", "C5", "C6"]
D = ["D1", "D2", "D3", "D4", "D5", "D6"]

supply = {
    "C1": 97,
    "C2": 63,
    "C3": 114,
    "C4": 172,
    "C5": 79,
    "C6": 66,
}

demand = {
    "D1": 19,
    "D2": 156,
    "D3": 14,
    "D4": 36,
    "D5": 138,
    "D6": 74,
}

cost = {
    "C1": {"D1": 8,  "D2": 4,  "D3": 18, "D4": 14, "D5": 20, "D6": 20},
    "C2": {"D1": 20, "D2": 8,  "D3": 17, "D4": 13, "D5": 15, "D6": 15},
    "C3": {"D1": 10, "D2": 19, "D3": 14, "D4": 10, "D5": 19, "D6": 20},
    "C4": {"D1": 2,  "D2": 20, "D3": 4,  "D4": 7,  "D5": 7,  "D6": 9},
    "C5": {"D1": 3,  "D2": 6,  "D3": 8,  "D4": 6,  "D5": 18, "D6": 3},
    "C6": {"D1": 6,  "D2": 1,  "D3": 14, "D4": 15, "D5": 20, "D6": 16},
}

# -----------------------------
# Model
# -----------------------------
model = pulp.LpProblem("Vehicle_Dispatch_Plan", pulp.LpMinimize)

# Decision variables: integer, non‑negative
x = pulp.LpVariable.dicts("x", (C, D), lowBound=0, cat="Integer")

# Objective: minimize total fuel cost
model += pulp.lpSum(cost[c][d] * x[c][d] for c in C for d in D), "Total_Fuel_Cost"

# -----------------------------
# Constraints
# -----------------------------
# R1: supply limits at each hub
for c in C:
    model += (
        pulp.lpSum(x[c][d] for d in D) <= supply[c],
        f"R1_supply_{c}"
    )

# R2: demand must be met exactly at each outlet
for d in D:
    model += (
        pulp.lpSum(x[c][d] for c in C) == demand[d],
        f"R2_demand_{d}"
    )

# R3: non‑negative variables (named even though lowBound already enforces it)
for c in C:
    for d in D:
        model += (
            x[c][d] >= 0,
            f"R3_nonneg_{c}_{d}"
        )

# -----------------------------
# Solve
# -----------------------------
model.solve(pulp.HiGHS(msg=False, timeLimit=120))

# -----------------------------
# Output
# -----------------------------
print("Status:", pulp.LpStatus[model.status])
print("Total fuel cost =", pulp.value(model.objective))

print("\nDispatch plan (vehicles from hub -> outlet):")
for c in C:
    for d in D:
        qty = int(pulp.value(x[c][d]))
        if qty > 0:
            print(f"  {c} -> {d}: {qty}")

import pulp

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Data
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Supplies
supply = {
    "Alpha": 68,
    "Beta": 187,
    "Gamma": 104,
    "Delta": 179,
}

# Demands
demand = {
    "North": 114,
    "South": 107,
    "East": 107,
    "West": 44,
}

# Travel costs
cost = {
    ("Alpha", "North"): 6,
    ("Alpha", "South"): 15,
    ("Alpha", "East"): 18,
    ("Alpha", "West"): 10,
    ("Beta",  "North"): 20,
    ("Beta",  "South"): 17,
    ("Beta",  "East"): 1,
    ("Beta",  "West"): 18,
    ("Gamma", "North"): 10,
    ("Gamma", "South"): 4,
    ("Gamma", "East"): 5,
    ("Gamma", "West"): 9,
    ("Delta", "North"): 4,
    ("Delta", "South"): 4,
    ("Delta", "East"): 18,
    ("Delta", "West"): 5,
}

centers = list(supply.keys())
offices = list(demand.keys())

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model = pulp.LpProblem("Technician_Dispatch", pulp.LpMinimize)

# Decision variables: x_{Center}_{Office}
x = {}
for c in centers:
    for o in offices:
        var_name = f"x_{c}_{o}"
        x[(c, o)] = pulp.LpVariable(var_name, lowBound=0, cat="Integer")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Objective: minimize total travel cost
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model += pulp.lpSum(cost[(c, o)] * x[(c, o)] for c in centers for o in offices), "Total_Travel_Cost"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Requirements (constraints)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# R1 – Alpha supply
model += (
    pulp.lpSum(x[("Alpha", o)] for o in offices) <= supply["Alpha"],
    "R1_supply_Alpha",
)

# R2 – Beta supply
model += (
    pulp.lpSum(x[("Beta", o)] for o in offices) <= supply["Beta"],
    "R2_supply_Beta",
)

# R3 – Gamma supply
model += (
    pulp.lpSum(x[("Gamma", o)] for o in offices) <= supply["Gamma"],
    "R3_supply_Gamma",
)

# R4 – Delta supply
model += (
    pulp.lpSum(x[("Delta", o)] for o in offices) <= supply["Delta"],
    "R4_supply_Delta",
)

# R5 – North demand
model += (
    pulp.lpSum(x[(c, "North")] for c in centers) == demand["North"],
    "R5_demand_North",
)

# R6 – South demand
model += (
    pulp.lpSum(x[(c, "South")] for c in centers) == demand["South"],
    "R6_demand_South",
)

# R7 – East demand
model += (
    pulp.lpSum(x[(c, "East")] for c in centers) == demand["East"],
    "R7_demand_East",
)

# R8 – West demand
model += (
    pulp.lpSum(x[(c, "West")] for c in centers) == demand["West"],
    "R8_demand_West",
)

# R9 – non‑negative integer variables (explicitly named)
for c in centers:
    for o in offices:
        model += (
            x[(c, o)] >= 0,
            f"R9_nonneg_{c}_{o}",
        )

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Solve
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model.solve(pulp.HiGHS(msg=False, timeLimit=120))

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Output
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
print(f"Status: {pulp.LpStatus[model.status]}")
print(f"Total travel cost = {pulp.value(model.objective)}\n")
for c in centers:
    for o in offices:
        qty = x[(c, o)].varValue
        if qty > 0:
            print(f"{c} -> {o}: {int(qty)} technicians (cost {cost[(c, o)]} each)")
